purpose: Describe a recurring emotional response, or include opposite circumstances.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
V dictionary + につけ; paired N / predicates + につけ
Whenever I hear this song, I remember my hometown.
Whenever I look at the photograph, the cold of that day returns to me.
Whether good or bad, I want you to tell me the result.
formation: V dictionary + につけ; paired N / predicates + につけ
restrictions: Single use often means whenever; repeated use includes both occasions.
mistake: Interpret the pattern through its recurrence or paired alternatives.
